arguments.summary: F-12’s water cut drop at end-2014 was a workover, not reservoir change. After a 32-day shut-in the well was plugged higher up at 3150 m and reperforated in a shallow clean zone 3126–3131 m, cutting off almost all of the water entry seen on logs. That cut water cut from about 0.97 to 0.31 and lifted oil rate to about 862 Sm3/d. The 2010 plug at 3210 m was much deeper and closed only the bottom water, so water cut kept rising.

findings.claim: At end-2014 F-12 was shut in for 32 days from 2014-11-30, then reperforated after a plug was set at 3150 m, and water cut fell from 0.97 to 0.31.
findings.detail: Shut-in 2014-11-30 for 32 days (E2); workover 2014-11-26 installed 7" EVO plug with mid element at 3150 m and perforated new zone 3126.2-3139.7 mMD, recorded perforations 3126.2-3130.7 mMD (E3, E8); monthly water_cut 0.9665 in 2014-10 to 0.3107 in 2015-01 (E5).

findings.claim: Oil rate after the workover rose to 862 Sm3/d, more than four times the 186 Sm3/d just before.
findings.detail: 2014-11 oil_rate_per_producing_day 185.7 Sm3/d, 2015-01 862.38 Sm3/d (E5); uptime 0.8069 to 0.9618 across shut-in (E5).

findings.claim: The 2010 plug was set deeper at 3210 m with no new perforations and left most water in the well.
findings.detail: Installed 5.72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element on 2010-09-23, no perforations listed (E3, E7); PLT 2010-09 shows oil comes in 3132-3165 m and water 3165-3243 m (E4); shares below 3210 m: oil 0.011-0.015, water 0.325-0.376, so deep plug could remove only ~32-38% of water (E9); monthly water_cut after: 2010-09 0.6354, 2010-10 0.6593, 2010-11 0.6969, rising to 0.89 by end 2012 (E6).

findings.claim: The 2014 plug at 3150 m could shut off almost all water, and the new shallow perforations restored oil above it.
findings.detail: Plug mid element at 3150 m (E8); PLT 2010-09 shares below 3150 m: oil 0.808 low rate / 0.734 medium, water 0.971 low / 1.0 medium (E9); new perforations 3126.2-3130.7 mMD sit above plug depth and above main oil entry 3132-3165 m seen on PLT (E4, E8).

Made FG check of TDS. Serviced TDS. RIH with 36" hole opener. Drilled 36" hole section from 145 m to 250 m MD.

Drilled 36" hole section to TD at 258 m MD. Displaced well to 1,40 sg mud. POOH with 36" hole opener BHA. Rigged up for running 30" conductor. Ran 30" conductor. Started running 4 3/4" cement stinger inside conductor.
Dismounted and mounted tension cylinders. RIH with production riser to 100 m MD.

RIH with PR tensioner joint. MU PR landing stand, RIH and landed riser. Locked TBC connector. Waited on Simens rig ESD test. Pressure tested PR to 200 bar. Install centralizer and boat collision stool on centralizer deck.
MU tensioner ring assembly. POOH and LD PR RT. Installed hatch on F-12 and suspended operation to F-7.
Skidded rig from F-12 to F-15. Changed wire on port aft crane big hook.
Built scaffolding at the well head deck and in the moon pool. Installed surface riser, BOP and tension cylinders.
Nippled up slick jnt, diverter and torqued up the BOP. RIH and installed the Bowl Protector at 20.9 m. Retrieved the Annulus Insert at 139.9 m. Retrieved the Bowl Protector.
RIH with 10 3/4" Tie Back and made up into sub sea well. Pressure tested Tie Back connector to 345 bars. Attempted to lock the Surface hanger, with the Adjustment sub.
Retrieved landing string. Installed BPV. Nippled down BOP and Riser. Installed dart in BPV. Terminated control lines. Installed extension spool.
Installed the WH extension spool, Xmas tree and the production Co-flex hose.
Leak tested X-mas tree connections to 30/345 bars 5/10 min. Lined up and leak tested production line 50/180 bars 5/10 min. Inflow tested LMV and HMV against BPV.
Sent firing command to E-Fire firing head in TCP guns and perforated well from 3130 to 3281 mMDRT.

Handed well over from Production. RU HMV and DHSV to local control panel. Installed test and bleed manifold on to XMT KWV. Performed line test from KWV to cmt unit. Attempted to leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min.

Operated and greased up leaking PWV. Leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min. Installed WL BOP and riser on XMT. Tested shear seals on WL BOP. Installed combination toolstring in riser. MU lubricator. Leak test WL riser, BOP and lubricator. Equalize and open HMV and DHSV. RIH with combination toolstring and tagged TCP guns at 3260.5 m. Performed correlation log in 7" liner. POOH and prepared for inflow test of HMV.

Inflow tested HMV to 81-5 bar/10 min. Broke lubricator and LD toolstring. Installed PLT toolstring in riser. MU lubricator and leak tested at in-situ sub. Equalized and opened HMV. RIH with PLT toolstring on 7/16" EWL from surface to 2929 m. Performed stationary logging at DHPG depth. Continued RIH from 2929 m to 3030 m to perform shut-in station logs and 4 PLT tool calibration passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Bean up well to 4500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 high rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Choked back flow to 3000 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 medium rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD.

Choked back flow to 1500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 low rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Shut-in well. POOH with PLT toolstring. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV and MMV for handover. BO lubricator and LD toolstring. LD lubricator. RD and LD WL riser.

RD BOP from XMT. Leak test XMT cross, KWV and tree cap. Hand well over to Mærsk Production. Cleared and cleaned rig floor of remaining WL equipment. Transferred operation to F-99 for PRS-and 5-yearly BOP classification.
Waited on access to well. Took over well. Rigged up WL riser and BOP.

RU WL equipment. Installed BHA into lubricator. RIH with PLT. Performed spinner calibration. Performed depth correlation with GR/CCL. Took stationary reading at 2929 m. Ran PLT shut in pass. Took stationary readings. Beaned up well. Waited for stable flow.

Waited for stable flow aprox. 5050 Sm3/d with PLT at 3080 m. Attempted to RIH at various speed. No-go. Reduced flow rate to 3000 Sm3/d. Took stationary readings at 3080, 3155, 3200 and 3250 m. Logged flowing passes between 3030 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Reduced flow rate to 1500 Sm3/d. Logged flowing passes between 3000 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Unable to log down on both flowing rates at 10/20/30 m/min. POOH with PLT. Changed tool string. RIH with 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 800 m.
Installed 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element. RD wireline pressure control equipment and handed well over to production department.
Spotted some equpment. Waited on weather, wind above 40 knots.
Spotted WL equipment. Checked equipment together with rig electrician.
Spotted equipment. Well handed over from Production dept. to D&W. Started to rig up on wellhead.

Completed rigging up wireline equipment. Leak tested rig up to 20/345 bar. Run in hole with Halliburton EVO plug. Pulled out of hole after tool failure at 1400 m. Started to prepare back up toolstring.
Installed 7" EV0 plug with mid element at 3150 m. Perforated new zone from 3126,2 -3139,7 mMD. POOH with perforating gun.
POOH with perfoartion gun. Inflow tested well barriers. Rigged down WL equipment. Operation completed.

- Rig up WL well control equipment, pressure tested same - Bullheaded washpill and sea water into the well - Set and pressure tested deepset plug
- Pressure tested and inflow tested deepset plug - Set and pressure tested from above shallow set plug - N/D Xtree and spacer spool - Installed HP riser - Started to N/U BOP
- Finished N/U BOP. Performed connector test - RIH w/ THRT, locked to TH - Open shallow set barrier plug - Troubleshoot communication w/ DHSV
- Pulled TH to surface - Pulled 500m of tubing and L/D DHSV - RIH and performed CBL log - R/D WL
- Circulated well to clean sea water - Set balance cement plug in 9 5/8in csg - Pulled and L/D 600m of 7in tubing - RIH w/ tubing on spear and tagged cement plug - Released spear from tubing and POOH
- Tagged cement plug - Left tubing in hole - Pulled MS-T seal - Cut 10 3/4in tie-back csg - Pull 10 3/4in surface csg hanger and tie-back above the cut - Attempted to release tie-back adapter
- Attempted to release tieback adapter several times w/ no success - Perforated below 10 3/4in subsea csg hanger - Circulated gas out
- POOH w/ guns - Cut 10 3/4in csg at 887m - Attempted to release tieback adapter w/ left hand string. No success - P/U cutter BHA
- Cut in the middle of tieback adapter - Attempted to fish top part of tieback adapter - Cut tieback adapter, second attempt - Fished top part of tieback adapter - Started milling tieback adapter
- Milled through tieback adapter and 10 3/4in subsea csg hanger - Dressed off csg stump - RIH w/ spear BHA to pull 10 3/4in csg fish
- Pulled 10 3/4in csg fish on spear - Pulled 750m of 10 3/4in csg and L/D same - Cut 14in csg and set EZSV in 14in csg - RIH w/ perforating assembly

- Perforated 14" casing below CH - Installed 14" EZSV at 854 mMD - Attempted to RIH with RTTS and PT EZSV - Displaced annulus between 14" and 20" casing to clean SW - Pumped and displaced cement in annulus between 14" and 20" casing - Displaced well to SW - WOC. Meanwhile: Performed maintenance
- WOC. Meanwhile: Performed maintenance - Pressure tested cement in annulus between 14" and 20" csg - Placed cement plug inside 14" casing
- N/D BOP and diverter - Pulled HP riser - Installed hatch on well F-12
- Skidded cantilever to well F-12 - Cut riser at 134,9 m - Cut and L/O Multibowl and tensioner joint - Cut and pulled riser
- Cut and pulled riser - Installed hatches - Skidded rig to well F-11 B

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. A job's date is the day the work was done; kind is drilling, completion, workover (work on a producing or injecting well) or abandonment. Ask for one day to see every operation line.

result.note: A production log measures the flow passing each depth while the well flows; going up, it grows past each zone that produces. A share at a depth is the part of the pass's oil or water entering below that depth (1 at the bottom of the well's inflow, 0 above the top zone). comes_in_from_m to to_m holds 90% of each phase's inflow. Only shares are given: the files' rates have no units, and the plots' are downhole volumes. A plug set at a depth shuts off what enters below it: the shares below say what it could remove. Each survey's passes were run at several surface rates. A survey read off pictures carries the checks of that reading.

result.summary: Installed 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element. RD wireline pressure control equipment and handed well over to production department.

rows: Continued RIH with 5,72" EVO plug to 3220 m.
Performed depth correlation passes. POOH to setting depth and activated DPU. Installed plug with mid element at 3210 m and top plug at 3209,3 m. Lost 400 lbs. WHP 98,7 bar.
Closed well. WHP = 98.6 bar. Bled down and inflow tested HMV.
Bled off and flushed lubricator with N2.
Opened HMV and bled down pressure above DHSV against test separator to 1 bar. Pumped 200 litres of MEG into well. Inflow tested DHSV.
Leak tested x-mas tree cross. 20/100 bar for 5/10 min.
Held prejob meeting regarding RD WL equipment with all personnel involved in operation. LD lubricator onto catwalk machine. (HTS)
Disconnected and lifted upper riser to rigfloor with top drive. Disconnected and lifted BOP away in moon pool area. Disconnect and lifted lower riser to rig floor.
Installed x-mas tree top cap and KWV cap. Leak tested both. 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.

Cleaned up in wellhead area. Transfered controll of DHSV and HMV to platform system. Handed well over to Maersk Prod. department. Meanwhile started to skid rig to next location. --------------------------------- END OF OPERATION---------------------------------------------

result.summary: Installed 7" EV0 plug with mid element at 3150 m. Perforated new zone from 3126,2 -3139,7 mMD. POOH with perforating gun.
result.planned: Rig down WL equipment, Skid rig to F-1C and rig up WL equipment.

rows: Continued to re-build cable head. Time consuming to build due to stiff cords on 7/16" cable together with narrow holes in cablehead cone.
Lifted tools to rig floor for testing of toolstring through cablehead. Meanwhile held toolbox talk for installing the BHA into lubricator.
Installed toollstring into lubricator and Leak tested QTS to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Meanwhile held toolbox talk for the plug run.
Opened HMV and equalized acoss swab using well pressure.
RIH w/BHA #2 7" EVO plug from surface to 1400 m. WHP 51 bar. Performed well control drill: Leakage in grease injection head. Stopped each 300 meters to perform P/U weight.
Continued to RIH from 1400 meter to 3135 m. Stopped each 300 meters to perform P/U weight.
Correlated BHA across interval 3135 - 3050 m . Set plug with mid packer element at 3150 m. Observed 400 lbs drop in tension. WHP 47 bar.
POOH with BHA#2 from 3150 m to surface. Hung slightly up in the packer area. Continued to POOH.
Closed SV. Had to wait on production department for bleeding of, due to problems with a gas compressor.
Bled of lubricator and inflow tested SV & HMV. Purged lubricator with N2.
Held toolbox talk prior to L/D toolstring.
Lifted Halliburton perforating toolstring to drill floor and started to prepare guns.
Held toolbox talk prior to arm the perforating guns.
Installed BHA #3 (4 5/8" Perforating gun) into lubricator. Stabbed lubricator and tested QTS to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Equalized and opened SV and HMV. WHP 46 bar.

RIH w/BHA #3 (4 5/8" Perforating gun) from surface to 3135 meters. WHP 46 bar. Stopped each 500 meters and pulled up 50 meters. Depth P/U weight 500 m 1410 lbs 1000 m 2130 lbs 1500 m 2950 lbs 2000 m 3650 lbs 2500 m 4400 lbs 3000 m 4900 lbs
Performed three correlation passes across interval 3135 - 3050 m. Positioned gun with top shot at 3126,2 m & bottom shot at 3130,7 mMD. WHP 45 bar.
Activated perforation guns. Observed current increase and drop in tension of 200 lbs. No change in WHP at 45 bar. Started POOH.
POOH with BHA #3 from 3131 m to 480 m. WHP 45 bar.
Held toolbox talk prior to take guns out of hole. Included toolbox talk for rigging down WL equipment.

result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.
